projects.name: Cloni — Outfit Recommender
projects.description: A responsive outfit-discovery concept for browsing and saving looks by occasion and style, with an optional guided front-and-back clothing scan. The local Python YOLOS Fashionpedia detector estimates garment labels, colors, confidence scores, and bounding boxes. AI text recommendations receive detected garment details rather than photos. Scan results are estimates, not body measurements or fit advice.
